verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party offline-mode docs say Terminal can store payments locally on the POS device or smart reader during connectivity issues. They also say the SDK or smart reader automatically forwards stored payments to Stripe once the network is restored, which matches the store-and-forward story directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of offline operation, and documentation depth on offline limits (e.g., amount caps, supported reader types, failure handling for declined forwarded payments).

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can keep taking card payments when the internet drops, with transactions stored and forwarded when connectivity returns

citations.quote: If you have internet connectivity issues, Stripe Terminal allows you to store payments locally on your POS device or smart reader. When a network connection is restored, the SDK or smart reader automatically forwards any stored payments to Stripe.
